children: Frank A. Selden, as trustee of the Gratitude 2022 Trust, disclosed a 10.8% stake in AGNT, Inc. common stock. The filing, dated September 8, 2026, follows his appointment as successor trustee on September 3, 2026, after the prior trustee’s death. The move also comes alongside a deal for AGNT, Inc. to buy back a large block of the trust’s shares.

Selden agreed that AGNT, Inc. will repurchase 8,693,290 shares from the Gratitude 2022 Trust, subject to closing conditions. The trust notes the deal is “to purchase 8,693,290 shares of Common Stock,” and adds, “The purchase price for the Purchased Shares will be $3.68 per share,” reflecting a 10% discount to the five-day VWAP.

Beyond this agreed sale, the trust holds the shares for investment and may sell more over time for liquidity, diversification, tax and estate planning, and charitable goals. It may use open market sales, registered offerings, private deals, or Rule 10b5-1 plans depending on circumstances.

The Gratitude 2022 Trust is a Nevada-governed trust, and Frank A. Selden serves as its trustee. Selden is a retired tax attorney who oversees the trust’s holdings and related transactions for its beneficiaries. As trustee, he typically seeks flexible liquidity options and tax-efficient execution when managing concentrated stock positions.
